purpose: This table is a small reference lookup mapping two-letter carrier codes to their full airline names, intended to be joined into flight-level fact tables that only carry the carrier code.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on carrier to resolve airline_name for reporting; treat carrier as the unique key since it is the declared grain.
limitations: The bronze table showed no duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) and no nulls in either business column, so no deduplication or null-handling logic was needed beyond dropping the three Airbyte capture-metadata columns.
